text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: *gasp*... *pant*... Digitan did it...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
And—I got to see it all for myself. The 
brilliant shine of the Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"The resolve to run is precious. That's 
what I thought, but... perhaps the 
feelings the Umamusume-chan pour into 
their races are..."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Way more earnest and deep! That's 
definitely why Doto-san looked so dazzling 
to me!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
If only I could support this radiance 
without causing trouble for anyone!
U-U-Uuuu...
Waaaaaaaahn!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? That girl... Was just running 
alongside me...

text_block_list.name: Defeated Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't even make the board... With my 
skill level, there's no way I can handle 
future graded stakes... Waaaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Defeated Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I...

text_block_list.name: Defeated Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"Pull yourself together! Hold your head 
high! Even if you lost, you gave it 
everything you had to get here, didn't 
you?"

text_block_list.name: Defeated Trainer
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume who placed higher just 
worked harder than me. That's all there is 
to it.

text_block_list.name: Defeated Umamusume
text_block_list.text: U-Uuuu...

text_block_list.name: Defeated Trainer
text_block_list.text:
True, with this many losses in a row, 
things might look grim for a while. But 
the Twinkle Series goes on!

text_block_list.name: Defeated Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Someday we'll run in a GⅠ and prove them 
all wrong. You're ready for the Winning 
Live, right?

text_block_list.name: Defeated Umamusume
text_block_list.text: "...Yes! Yes, I'm off!"

text_block_list.name: Defeated Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Losing doesn't mean it's over! Because... 
there's always tomorrow!
(Dadadada!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: No way...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Supporting someone without causing trouble 
is a lie... There's no way... I can do 
that...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Because whenever they run, there's always 
a winner, and someone who loses, right?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
How can you say losing is precious with a 
straight face? No matter how naive and 
delusional someone is, there's no way they 
could say that...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
You can't stay uninvolved. Once you decide 
to race, you have to engage at some point. 
And so—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Because of that connection... Uma Musume 
are...

"Through this race, Agnes Digital seemed 
to change, if only just a little."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, about our future plans... Can I 
say something that might sound a bit 
unlike me?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I realized that I want to run in one 
no matter what. —A G1 race, that is.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I've committed a rudeness 
worthy of a flaming dogeza to that 
Umamusume-chan...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Now that it's come to this, I wanna enter! 
I'll enter and make them realize that 
Agnes Digi-tan was strong, while also...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I want to see... I want to judge for 
myself. Just how much resolve these 
Umamusume carry as they head into a GⅠ 
race!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, which race do you think would be 
your top recommendation for me?

—I think. Among the GⅠ races open to 
Classic-class Umamusume, the race with a 
distance suited for Agnes Digital right 
now is...
choice_data_list: My top recommendation is the NHK Mile Cup.
My top recommendation is the NHK Mile Cup.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
The NHK Mile Cup! If Trainer recommends it 
that strongly, then it's a sure thing! 
I'll enter that one! And then—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Without fail, for her sake as well!

A chance encounter with the sorrow of 
victory and defeat. That was the spark 
that set Agnes Digital's future into 
motion.
